'''Eddie Turcotte''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[2001 Washington State Championship]] on 21 April 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Phil Aasen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2156">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-26-washington-state-championship-2001d2156/ washington-state-championship-2001], DeckTech (Phillip "Karrdeshark" Aasen, 26 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-26-washington-state-championship-2001d2156/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
